title: Property grid
summary: A property inspector: fields in collapsible groups (text, number, unit, range, colour, select, switch), each a labelled real control, with per-property validation and a pk-property-change event. Uses the same field vocabulary as pk-settings-page.

props.name: config
props.description: { groups: [{ heading, collapsed?, fields: [{ key, type: 'text'|'number'|'unit'|'range'|'color'|'select'|'switch', label, required?, disabled?, hidden?, visibleWhen?, options?, units?, min?, max?, step? }] }] }. A unit property is a number with a unit picker: units is a list (default ['px']), its value is { value, unit } and min/max apply to the number (the message names the unit). A select's options are [{ value, label? }] or plain strings; range is a pk-range slider with its value shown, color is a #rrggbb text field with a swatch. visibleWhen is { key, equals } or { key, in: [...] } against the current values and hides the property (and skips its validation) when false. Labels sit beside the value once the grid is 480px wide, above it otherwise.

props.name: values
props.description: The property values keyed by field key; set again to update the controls (for example when the selected object changes).

props.name: errors
props.description: Host-side validation messages keyed by field key (for example from a server); shown under the property and marking it invalid. Built-in rules (required, number min/max) apply as well.

props.name: state
props.description: Live per-property state keyed by field key: { key: { disabled?, hidden? } }. Set again to enable, disable, show or hide a property without rebuilding the grid; hidden here overrides visibleWhen.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every property (a field's own disabled: true stays disabled either way).

events.name: pk-property-change
events.detail: { key: string, value: any, values: object, valid: boolean }
events.description: The user committed a new value for one property; carries every current value and whether all properties are valid.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: A placeholder message shown while config.groups is empty.

parts.name: groups
parts.description: The pk-accordion holding one pk-accordion-item per group.

writes.why: The unit editor's picker is a pk-select the grid created in its own shadow tree; it is named after its property.
The unit picker is disabled together with its number input (state, disabled).
The colour editor's swatch is created by the grid itself inside its own shadow tree and slotted into the pk-input prefix.
A property row (a pk-field or switch the grid created in its own shadow tree) is hidden by visibleWhen or state.

a11y: Each property is a labelled real control (pk-input, pk-select, pk-switch), so Tab, arrow keys and Space work as in those elements (a unit property's picker is its own labelled select, named "<label> unit"); groups are pk-accordion-item disclosures (Enter or Space toggles). An invalid property sets aria-invalid and shows its message as a pk-alert next to it, so an error is never colour alone.

examples.title: Unit editor: a number with a unit picker; Width is above its maximum, so it shows its message naming the unit
Range and colour editors; Threshold is only shown while Mode is Custom (visibleWhen)
Grouped properties; Width is below its minimum, so it shows its validation message

methods.name: setValue(key, value)
methods.description: Sets one property's value without rebuilding the grid, so focus, scroll position and open groups stay; validation and visibleWhen are re-evaluated.
